**Southampton vs West Ham United (Premier League, Boxing Day fixture on December 26, 2024, 15:00 GMT at St Mary’s Stadium, Southampton home).**[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)[[2]](https://insights.betfred.com/football/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-predictions-odds-betting-preview-thursday-26-december-2024/)

This is a home match for Southampton. All details below draw exclusively from information and previews published on or before December 25, 2024. ### Standings and Recent Form (as of late December 2024)
- **Southampton**: Bottom of the Premier League table (20th place) with just 5–6 points from 16–17 games and only one league win in 17 attempts. They had scored just 11 league goals all season and failed to score in their last three league matches (including a toothless 0-0 draw at Fulham on or around December 22, where they managed only one shot on target).[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)[[2]](https://insights.betfred.com/football/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-predictions-odds-betting-preview-thursday-26-december-2024/)
- **West Ham**: 14th place with 20 points. They were unbeaten in their last three matches (a win over Wolves and 1-1 draws with Bournemouth and Brighton), marking their longest unbeaten run of the season.[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)

### Head-to-Head History
- Overall across 182 meetings: Southampton 52 wins, 49 draws, West Ham 81 wins (West Ham historically more successful).[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)
- At St Mary’s specifically: West Ham winless in their last four visits (dating back to December 2019) and had only three wins in 15 outings at the venue since the start of the millennium.[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)

### Injuries, Suspensions, and Team News (pre-match)
**Southampton**:
- Out/sidelined: Gavin Bazunu, Armel Bella-Kotchap, Will Smallbone, Maxwel Cornet, Ross Stewart. - Jack Stephens available after serving a four-match ban. - Aaron Ramsdale returned in goal after missing the previous five league games with a broken finger. - Predicted shape under new manager Ivan Jurić (his first game in charge; he had watched the Fulham draw from the stands): likely a back-three system (e.g., 5-4-1 or similar). Flynn Downes noted as a frequent fouler (31 fouls, multiple recent bookings).[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)[[2]](https://insights.betfred.com/football/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-predictions-odds-betting-preview-thursday-26-december-2024/)

**West Ham**:
- Lucas Paquetá suspended (booking accumulation). - Carlos Soler available after serving his own suspension. - Konstantinos Mavropanos was substituted at half-time vs Brighton; Jean-Clair Todibo expected to feature. - Michail Antonio remained sidelined; Niclas Füllkrug started in attack (his first Premier League start) with Jarrod Bowen shifted wide. - Predicted lineup: 4-2-3-1 with Łukasz Fabiański in goal, midfield including Edson Álvarez and Tomáš Souček, and attack featuring Bowen, Mohammed Kudus, and Füllkrug.[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)

### Travel, Venue, and Other Factors
- West Ham faced a relatively short ~83-mile trip south from London to Southampton, limiting fatigue compared to longer journeys.[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)
- Venue: St Mary’s Stadium (Southampton home). Boxing Day fixtures typically benefit from strong home crowds and atmosphere, providing a potential edge for the hosts despite their poor form. - No specific mentions of unusual pitch, climate, or altitude issues in previews. - Broader context/storylines: Southampton were in a desperate relegation fight and hoping for a “new manager bounce” under Ivan Jurić (appointed recently after Martin’s dismissal). West Ham faced mounting pressure, with their next fixtures after this including Liverpool and Manchester City; a win here was seen as important to build momentum. Previews anticipated a potentially low-scoring, attritional game given Southampton’s defensive organization in recent outings and West Ham’s recent 1-1 draws.[[1]](https://thetopflight.com/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-premier-league-tv-channel-prediction-team-news-and-lineups)[[2]](https://insights.betfred.com/football/southampton-vs-west-ham-united-predictions-odds-betting-preview-thursday-26-december-2024/)

These factors (new manager effect, home advantage vs historical away struggles for West Ham at the venue, squad availability, and fixture context) go beyond raw team strength and could influence the outcome. Sources are noted inline from December 24–25, 2024 previews.

factors.factor: West Ham's historically poor record at St Mary's Stadium
factors.impact: West Ham is winless in their last four visits to St Mary's (since December 2019) and has secured only three wins in 15 outings at the venue since the start of the millennium. This specific head-to-head pattern significantly disadvantages West Ham on the road against Southampton.

factors.factor: Key West Ham player absences and attacking uncertainties
factors.impact: West Ham will be without key creative player Lucas Paquetá (suspended) and striker Michail Antonio (sidelined). Additionally, Niclas Füllkrug is making his first Premier League start in attack, introducing an element of inexperience and uncertainty that could blunt West Ham's offensive threat.

This is Ivan Jurić's first game in charge of Southampton. A 'new manager bounce' often leads to increased effort and a tactical refresh. Combined with the desperate motivation from being at the bottom of the league and the strong home crowd support typical of a Boxing Day fixture, Southampton may perform above their recent league form.

factors.factor: Southampton's severe goal-scoring struggles and overall league form
factors.impact: Southampton is at the bottom of the Premier League table with only one league win in 17 attempts and has failed to score in their last three league matches. This profound inability to score goals remains a significant hindrance, even with other mitigating factors.
Southampton has several players out injured, including Gavin Bazunu, Armel Bella-Kotchap, Will Smallbone, Maxwel Cornet, and Ross Stewart, which weakens their squad depth and overall strength.

analysis.reasoning: While Southampton's overall league form and goal-scoring record are abysmal, leading to an initial bias against them, several specific factors suggest a significant adjustment is warranted for this particular Boxing Day fixture. West Ham has a well-documented and long-standing poor historical record when playing at St Mary's Stadium. Crucially, West Ham's attack will be severely hampered by the absence of key creative player Lucas Paquetá and striker Michail Antonio, with Niclas Füllkrug making his first Premier League start, potentially reducing their ability to break down a struggling Southampton side. These concrete disadvantages for West Ham, combined with the potential 'new manager bounce' under Ivan Jurić, the psychological boost of a desperate home team on Boxing Day, and the pre-match expectation of a low-scoring, attritional game, collectively make Southampton more competitive than their league position implies for this specific match. Although Southampton's profound inability to score remains a major concern, the confluence of West Ham's specific weaknesses for this encounter and Southampton's less tangible boosts warrants a small positive adjustment favoring Southampton to secure a result, shifting the prediction away from a straightforward West Ham win.
